layerRules.rule: x402 is payment evidence; it does not prove delegated authority, service success, or reputation eligibility.
AP2/FIDO/Verifiable Intent is delegated authority; mandates must bind actor, payee, purpose, cap, expiry, revocation, and audit refs.
MCP auth is protected resource access; it does not authorize spend or settlement.
Solana is settlement/program evidence; cluster, mint, program id, signature, confirmation, and allowlist evidence must be explicit.
RAP binds receipt/accounting/dispute/eval/reputation evidence across all lower layers.
